summary: Night Shift is a BFA photography thesis: a photo essay of one 400-metre street, Kettle Lane, shot every night between 2 AM and 4 AM for six weeks. It pairs 48 final frames with a written argument that 'empty' streets are never really empty.
purpose: To answer one question: does a street have a personality when its people are gone?

components.title: The 48-frame photo essay
components.detail: The final edit of 48 frames, indexed with date, time, lens and a one-line note per frame.

evidence.claim: frames/index.csv lists frames with date, time, lens and a note

components.title: Written thesis in chapters
components.detail: A method chapter (three self-imposed rules) and a findings chapter (what the street does at night).

evidence.claim: Chapter 1 sets three rules before the first night
Chapter 2 describes what the street does at night

decisions.title: Available light only
decisions.detail: One camera, one 35mm lens, no flash, no tripod. If the street was too dark, the frame was too dark.

evidence.claim: One camera, one 35mm lens, no flash, no tripod

decisions.title: Film to digital in week three
decisions.detail: Sodium street lamps turned film orange, so the author switched to digital and fixed white balance at 2800K.

evidence.claim: Switched from film to digital in week three because sodium lamps turned every roll orange
White balance set by hand to 2800K for the rest of the project

decisions.title: No staging
decisions.detail: Rule 3: if a fox does not walk past, there is no fox in the picture. The author says this rule gave the best frames.

evidence.claim: Rule 3 gave the author the best frames

highlights.title: 2,100 exposures, 48 kept
highlights.detail: Six weeks of nightly walks produced 2,100 exposures; 48 made the final edit.

evidence.claim: 2,100 exposures in total, 48 made the final edit

highlights.title: The street is louder at 3 AM
highlights.detail: The bakery ovens start around 3:10 AM, bins go out at 3:40 AM and the street gets loud for eleven minutes.

evidence.claim: The bakery switches on its ovens at about 3:10 AM
Bins go out at 3:40 AM and the street is loud for eleven minutes

highlights.title: A fox on 31 of 42 nights
highlights.detail: A fox crossed near number 27 on 31 of the 42 logged nights; only 9 people walked the full street in six weeks.

evidence.claim: A fox crossed near number 27 on 31 of the 42 nights
Only 9 people walked the full length of the street in six weeks

highlights.title: Thesis argument
highlights.detail: Empty streets are never empty; they are working for somebody else: the bakers, the bin crew, the fox.

evidence.claim: The street is working for somebody else: the bakers, the bin crew, the fox

limitations.title: Field notes not digitised
limitations.detail: The notes/ folder is mentioned but the field notes are still on paper.

evidence.claim: Field notes are still on paper
